shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright rectangular slab/pillar
human or anthropomorphic figure with visible arms and hands
horizontal register band of repeated motifs
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in low relief with figures stacked in horizontal registers, and both include profile animals with elongated snouted heads plus an anthropomorphic figure with prominent arms/hands. But A is sparse and highly schematic — isolated widely spaced quadrupeds, a row of arched motifs, a bird and a small crouching human on a plain empty ground — whereas B is a densely packed, curvilinear, horror-vacui composition of an elaborately costumed standing figure entwined with scrolled serpent forms and glyph-like panels, with no empty ground; the shared traits are generic to relief-carved steles rather than specific motifs in shared relationships.
